limitation: This evaluates detection of controlled synthetic anomaly patterns. It does not establish accuracy for diagnosing real physical sensor failures.

transformations: Raw CSV preserved byte-for-byte; finite numeric parsing without sign conversion
Source clock parsed without timezone conversion
Five feasibility-selected labels, 2024-01-01 inclusive to 2024-04-01 exclusive
Station grouping uses exact label, agency, state, district and coordinate tokens
exclusions: Other stations and out-of-window timestamps excluded from this bounded pilot
Malformed selected-station timestamps retained for quality audit, cannot be assigned to window
Conflicting duplicate timestamp values withheld from analytics
Q1 2024 was inspected before the event; not an untouched evaluation holdout

configuration.metadata_scope: Controlled benchmark assumptions only, never official instrument or operating metadata
configuration.negative_label: Unmodified historical control; no injected anomaly, not independently certified fault-free
configuration.metric_unit: One detector decision per paired historical window; abstained positives count as missed injections; abstained negatives excluded from FPR denominator and reported separately
configuration.latency_unit: Source-clock hours from injected pattern onset, conditional on detection; not wall-clock API or live delivery latency

split_note: Q1 used for development; Q2 first evaluated after config was saved. No tuning was performed on Q2 results. Same stations, separate source-time windows; this is not spatial generalization.
